newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Rorer cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rorer cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Christina Heuer said she downgraded pharmaceutical company Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc to neutral from buy.

-- In a report, Heuer said she feared a delay of one to two months in the reinstatement of production of Albuminar, a plasma product recalled in October. Production had been expected to be restarted Jan 1 but "that has not occurred," the report stated.
-- She cut her 1997 earnings estimate on the company to $3.95 from $4.15 and 1998 to $4.70 from $4.80.
-- Heuer said she would be a buyer of the stock at $70.
-- Rorer is majority owned by French chemicals group Rhone-Poulenc SA.
